kitPositioning: Fluent-aligned semantic slide tooling with HTML previews and editable PowerPoint output; not Microsoft brand certification.

designData.name: Fluent UI foundation token snapshot
designData.modifications: Converted stable static-frame token values to compact renderer-neutral JSON; omitted motion durations and curves and included no font or icon binaries.

designData.name: Fluent UI data visualization palette snapshot
designData.modifications: Converted qualitative and semantic palettes to static renderer-neutral JSON and added static presentation usage rules; no React or D3 runtime included.

runtimeDependencies.name: PptxGenJS
runtimeDependencies.purpose: Generate native editable PowerPoint Open XML packages from the shared scene.

securityBoundaries: Presentation assets are restricted to local SVG, PNG, and JPEG files.
ICNS, JXL, and HEIF inputs are prohibited because the pinned image-size dependency has denial-of-service advisories for those parsers.
Desktop PowerPoint preview automation refuses to run while an interactive PowerPoint session exists.

fonts.stack: Segoe UI Variable Display, Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

trademarks: Microsoft logos and product launch icons are not included. Add only approved brand assets under their applicable terms.
